Whenever a villan charecter card has 0 or fewer hp, it is destroyed and the players have won.

This says the exact same thing twice. Are they supposed to be different?

Once any villain character card reaches 0 (yes it can also be negative) the destruction trigger kicks in to check the win condition. If Lady Luck is in play and flips a Jinx, her destruction is prevented. Now that trigger is completely resolved. But the win condition check is a constant thing, you don't just check it after you deal damage. She still has 0 or fewer HP, so the destruction effect triggers immediately again. This effectively leads to you milling Kismets deck until you find a lucky card. Either it heals her enough to get back over 0 HP or dies finally passes the destroy check and the heros win. That is why it works that way. 

Basically, the destruction trigger is only related to HP, it does not require damage delt to trigger.

Take my AkashBuhta example. She plays Disrupt the Field. Playing a card is the trigger condition for the cards specified effects right? So we start doing what the card says. First we would destroy all Enviro cards. Now, lets say that an Explosive Wagon was one of those destroyed cards. The wagon has a triggered effect upon it being destroyed. Make a coherent argument for how you think it should work and why you think so. Other than that, iv explained how this works correctly the best I can. You don't have to accept it, but I'm going in circles here. 

Edit: The difference is in the first example, Fortune Smiles was the thing playing the extra card and the destruction target is Kismet herself. Fortune Smiles is broken up into two seperate distinct parts. The second was Lady Luck playing the card and the target was a Jinx under the effects of Imbued Vitality. Lady Luck plays the Lucky card in a different fashion coming from a totally different trigger. It makes a HUGE difference.

Look, I enjoy going over the minute details of card interactions. They can be very complex and its part of what keeps me interested in the game (hell I never considered Lady Luck protecting Kismet until now ya know?). But if we are going to have a constructive discussion on how these effects interact, we need to be consistent with the examples we use to illustrate how these things interact. I'm also sorry I called you a troll. That was unfair.
